candidate_sentence_map.S8: The EBITDA loss narrowed significantly by 77% to DKK 2.0 million, compared to a loss of DKK 9.3 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: This improvement was supported by cost optimizations, particularly in marketing, and a strategic agreement with Exsitec AB that transferred customer success activities in Sweden and Norway, positively impacting the EBITDA margin.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The EBIT loss also improved, decreasing to DKK 5.1 million from DKK 12.1 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The net loss for the year stood at DKK 6.6 million, a considerable reduction from the DKK 14.9 million loss recorded in 2024.

candidate_sentence_map.S19: Financial position changes included a negative consolidated equity of DKK 3.6 million, though the parent company, Konsolidator A/S, maintained positive equity of DKK 0.7 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: The company secured DKK 4.8 million through two private placements in 2025 to support operations and product development.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Cash flow from operating activities improved to a negative DKK 1.0 million from a negative DKK 9.2 million in 2024, aided by better working capital management and a shift toward annual invoicing.
candidate_sentence_map.S22: Intangible assets, primarily development costs for the Konsolidator Suite, increased to DKK 15.5 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S23: The company launched new components of the Konsolidator Suite, including a Financial Data Management solution and an FP&A tool, positioning itself as a broader financial reporting platform.
candidate_sentence_map.S24: For 2026, the company guides for revenue between DKK 27–29 million and expects positive EBITDA of DKK 1–2 million.
